<section_guide number="7" title="PoC Validation Plan">
<purpose>Demonstrate the Primary Persona's core ideal use cases and produce evidence for their approved intents.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What is the shortest connected demo that covers every approved core ideal use case?
2. What evidence shows that each use case intent, Feature, and success criterion passed or failed?
</questions>

<workflow>
Keep the same Primary Persona and use case intents from Section 3. Build the demo from that
persona's sequential actions; do not replace them with a capability tour or introduce another
persona. The flow may contain one block per core ideal use case, connected into the shortest
coherent demonstration.

Create one validation row per use case intent.
Create one validation row per Feature completion checkpoint and success criterion.
Use results a reviewer or participant can observe in the PoC.
Mark anything the PoC cannot test as "Not yet testable" rather than inventing evidence. Keep
feedback questions focused on comprehension, usefulness, trust, and the highest-impact assumption.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the demo flow, complete validation checklist, and feedback questions before saving.</completion>
</section_guide>
